title: Fake Payment Screenshot with Pending Status and Invalid UTR
text: Paid Rs 15,000 to Merchant via PhonePe. Payment Status is Pending. Awaiting bank confirmation. UTR: 89432. Money will reach within 24 hours. Visual notes: cropped status bar and edited amount.
description: Fake payment transaction with pending status presented as proof, invalid 5-digit UTR, and cropped status bar.
